hunks.baseline: Unlike when we first entered, the trip out was not as difficult as I had expected.
hunks.sol: Unlike the journey in, the way out wasn’t as difficult as I’d expected.

hunks.baseline: Part of that was because the whirlpools of Tianling Falls mostly spiraled outward. But it was also thanks to the veteran river bandits inside Water Dragon Stronghold, who had spent years working on boats and were making full use of their skills.
hunks.sol: Part of that was because the whirlpools of Tianling Falls mostly spiraled outward. It also helped that the veteran river bandits from Water Dragon Stronghold, who had spent years working aboard ships, were making full use of their skills.

hunks.baseline: Come to think of it, maybe it had been a little difficult after all.
hunks.sol: Come to think of it, maybe it was a little difficult after all.

hunks.baseline: But it was nothing we couldn’t handle. Even without powerful allies like Jeok Cheongang and Mungyeong, Cheongpung and I could get through most crises if we put our minds to it.
hunks.sol: Still, it was nothing we couldn’t handle. Even without powerful allies like Jeok Cheongang and Mungyeong, Cheongpung and I could overcome most crises if we stepped in.

hunks.baseline: The river bandits weren’t the only ones who had grown accustomed to Tianling Falls’ violent whirlpools. I had prepared in advance as well, and thrust both palms forward with all my strength.
hunks.sol: The river bandits weren’t the only ones who had grown accustomed to the violent whirlpools of Tianling Falls. I had prepared in advance as well, and thrust both palms forward with all my strength.

hunks.baseline: The tilting fast ship regained its balance. Now was the time to increase our speed and escape this damned whirlpool.
hunks.sol: The tilting swift ship regained its balance. Now it was time to pick up speed and escape this damned whirlpool.

hunks.baseline: I called out the name of the person I had stationed at the stern specifically for situations like this.
hunks.sol: I called out to the man I had stationed at the stern for precisely this situation.

hunks.baseline: “Oh, sorry, Benefactor. I didn’t mean to, but before I knew it…”
hunks.sol: “Oh, sorry, Benefactor. I didn’t mean to. Before I knew it…”

hunks.baseline: Dozens of palm shadows infused with powerful internal energy struck through the air and lashed the surface of the water. The resulting thrust sent the fast ship vaulting over the whirlpool of Tianling Falls before landing on the other side.
hunks.sol: Dozens of palm shadows laden with powerful internal energy tore through the air and slammed into the water. The resulting thrust sent the swift ship vaulting over the whirlpools of Tianling Falls before crashing down on the other side.

hunks.baseline: A towering spray of water fell over the ship’s hull. Gung Gibang and Hyuk Mujin, drenched from head to toe, muttered under their breath.
hunks.sol: A towering spray engulfed the hull. Drenched from head to toe in river water, Gung Gibang and Hyuk Mujin muttered under their breath.

hunks.baseline: “Damn it. Last time we got dunked, and now we’re getting drenched. We really get everything.”
hunks.sol: “Damn it. Last time we got dunked, and now we’re getting drenched. We really do get everything.”

hunks.baseline: “I swear on my life, once this is over, I’m never coming back to the Yangtze. Not ever. Every day feels like living as a goddamn beggar.”
hunks.sol: “I swear, once this is over, I’m never coming back to the Yangtze. Not ever. Every day feels like living the life of a goddamn beggar.”

hunks.baseline: “That’s true. It feels shitty to hear it, but you’re right. You’re right, but it still feels shitty.”
hunks.sol: “That’s true. It pisses me off, but you’re right. You’re right, and it still pisses me off.”

hunks.baseline: “Damn, I really do feel like a beggar.”
hunks.sol: “Damn. I really do feel like a beggar.”

hunks.baseline: Leaving behind the bickering of the two sweet-and-sour pork pieces who had now experienced both dipping and pouring sauce, the ship safely passed through Tianling Falls and sped across the Yangtze.
hunks.sol: Leaving behind the bickering of our two human pieces of sweet-and-sour pork—dunked on the way in and drenched on the way out—the swift ship cleared Tianling Falls safely and sped across the Yangtze.

hunks.baseline: About three shichen later, when the fast ship that had departed at dawn reached the ferry landing at Zaoyang, it was already close to noon.
hunks.sol: About three shichen later, the ship that had departed at dawn reached the ferry landing at Zaoyang. By then, it was already close to noon.

hunks.baseline: “The waters of the Yangtze do not reach Mount Longzhong, where the Zhuge Clan is located. From here, you will have to travel by land.”
hunks.sol: “The waterways of the Yangtze do not reach Mount Longzhong, where the Zhuge Clan is located. From here, you will have to travel by land.”

hunks.baseline: The deputy Stronghold Lord of Water Dragon Stronghold had come in Mu Song’s place. I nodded at his words.
hunks.sol: The deputy Stronghold Lord of Water Dragon Stronghold had come in Mu Song’s place. I nodded at his explanation.

hunks.baseline: Hubei Province had highly developed water and land transportation, but that did not mean all the Yangtze’s tributaries were connected. A boat could not travel where there was no water.
hunks.sol: Hubei Province had highly developed land and water transportation, but that didn’t mean every tributary of the Yangtze was connected. A boat couldn’t travel where there was no water.

hunks.baseline: Zaoyang and Mount Longzhong were relatively close to each other, so it would not take very long.
hunks.sol: Zaoyang and Mount Longzhong were relatively close, so the journey shouldn’t take long.

hunks.baseline: The Zhuge Clan retainer who had been ordered by Zhuge Feng to accompany us was not standing around idle, either.
hunks.sol: The Zhuge Clan retainer whom Zhuge Feng had ordered to accompany us wasn’t standing around idle, either.

hunks.baseline: “I will immediately send word to the Zaoyang branch and have carriages prepared. Relay stations have been established all along the main roads, so if you change carriages along the way, you will reach our family home in no time.”
hunks.sol: “I will send word to the Zaoyang branch immediately and have carriages prepared. Relay stations have been established all along the main roads, so if we change carriages along the way, we will reach our family home in no time.”

hunks.baseline: I had just gotten off the boat after roughly calculating the travel time in my head when—
hunks.sol: I had just stepped off the ship after roughly calculating the travel time in my head when—

hunks.baseline: A group of people appeared with the sound of perfectly synchronized footsteps and surrounded the ferry landing.
hunks.sol: A group appeared to the sound of perfectly synchronized footsteps and surrounded the ferry landing.

hunks.baseline: I frowned as I stared at the unwelcome guests.
hunks.sol: I frowned at the unwelcome guests.

hunks.baseline: Every one of them wore a blue silk martial uniform that gleamed with luster, and each had a fine-steel long sword hanging at his waist. Hyuk Mujin’s eyes widened.
hunks.sol: Every one of them wore a lustrous blue silk martial uniform and carried a high-quality steel longsword at their waist. Hyuk Mujin’s eyes widened.

hunks.baseline: “That’s Shu brocade, produced in Sichuan. It’s considered one of the finest kinds of silk in the world. My father dreamed of filling an entire warehouse with it. That’s how expensive and precious it is… And they made martial uniforms out of it. I don’t know who their employer is, but they must have a lot of money.”
hunks.sol: “That’s Shu brocade from Sichuan. It’s considered one of the finest silks under heaven. My father dreamed of filling an entire warehouse with it. That’s how expensive and precious it is… And they made martial uniforms out of it. I don’t know who their employer is, but they must be loaded.”

hunks.baseline: I had told the bastard to identify them, and he was evaluating the quality of their silk instead.
hunks.sol: I’d told the bastard to identify them, and he was evaluating the quality of their silk instead.

hunks.baseline: When I stared at him in disbelief, Gung Gibang clicked his tongue and cut in.
hunks.sol: As I stared at him in disbelief, Gung Gibang clicked his tongue and cut in.

hunks.baseline: “I can’t tell whether that bastard is a martial artist or a cloth merchant. Don’t waste your expectations on that Hyuk Family brat. Ask this old man instead.”
hunks.sol: “I can’t tell whether that bastard is a martial artist or a cloth merchant. Don’t expect anything from that Hyuk brat. Ask this elder instead.”

hunks.baseline: “I don’t know about the old man part, but I can make you a cripple. Tell us before my fist gets there.”
hunks.sol: “I don’t know about making you an elder, but I can make you a cripple. Tell us before my fist gets there.”

hunks.baseline: “They’re martial artists from Qingxia Hall. I told you, so please relax your fist a little.”
hunks.sol: “They’re martial artists from Qingxia Hall. I told you, so please loosen that fist a little.”

hunks.baseline: Gung Gibang glanced at my fist, which was still tightly clenched, and answered.
hunks.sol: Gung Gibang glanced at my still-clenched fist and answered.

hunks.baseline: “They aren’t an official sect, but they wield considerable influence in Hubei Province in various ways.”
hunks.sol: “They aren’t an official sect, but they wield considerable influence throughout Hubei Province.”

hunks.baseline: I cast a brief glance at the martial artists standing in formation in the distance.
hunks.sol: I glanced at the martial artists standing in formation in the distance.

hunks.baseline: They had made martial uniforms from expensive Shu brocade and carried quality swords, but that was all.
hunks.sol: They wore uniforms made of expensive Shu brocade and carried quality swords, but that was all.

hunks.baseline: Most were Second or Third Rate swordsmen who fell short of First Rate. Perhaps they cared more about their appearance than their martial arts, because every one of them was well built and handsome.
hunks.sol: Most were second- or third-rate swordsmen who didn’t even qualify as first-rate. Perhaps they cared more about their appearance than their martial arts, because every one of them was well built and handsome.

hunks.baseline: The K-pop craze that had begun in Korea must have spread beyond the world and reached the Murim as well.
hunks.sol: It almost made me wonder if the K-pop craze that had begun in Korea had crossed worlds and spread all the way to Murim.

hunks.baseline: Qingxia Bulletproof Martial Artist Corps. Maybe they had come to perform at some event under a name like that.
hunks.sol: Qingxia Bulletproof Martial Artist Corps. Maybe they had come to play a gig under a name like that.

hunks.baseline: “Those guys’ group name—or, no, their organization name—was Qingxia Hall, right? They’re that popular in Hubei?”
hunks.sol: “Those guys’ group name—or rather, their organization’s name—was Qingxia Hall, right? They’re actually a big deal in Hubei?”

hunks.baseline: “I heard they’re fairly influential.”
hunks.sol: “I’ve heard they throw considerable weight around.”

hunks.baseline: Did sect rankings in Hubei get decided by a popularity vote?
hunks.sol: Did Hubei decide its sect rankings through popularity votes?

hunks.baseline: I was seriously pondering the question when the Zhuge Clan retainer spoke.
hunks.sol: While I was seriously pondering the question, the Zhuge Clan retainer spoke.

hunks.baseline: “Yes. It was formed by the sons and daughters of influential people with varying degrees of power throughout Hubei Province. They are always running around together and causing all kinds of trouble, but they have such powerful backing that matters usually fizzle out without consequence.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. It was formed by the sons and daughters of influential people from across Hubei Province. They are always running around together and causing all kinds of trouble, but their powerful families protect them, so matters tend to fizzle out without consequence.”

hunks.baseline: “Oh. A rich-kid club.”
hunks.sol: “Oh. A gold-spoon club.”

hunks.baseline: So that was what they were. An empty cart making a great deal of noise, dressed up in gaudy finery wherever they went.
hunks.sol: So that was all they were. A noisy empty cart decked out in gaudy finery.

hunks.baseline: From the main road he had just mentioned, an extravagantly luxurious procession was approaching—more lavish than anything I had ever seen.
hunks.sol: An extravagantly luxurious procession was approaching from the main road he had just indicated—more lavish than anything I had ever seen.

hunks.baseline: “The heroes of Qingxia Hall are making their procession!”
hunks.sol: “The heroes of Qingxia Hall are passing through!”

hunks.baseline: At the shout of a middle-aged man with weasel whiskers and a thin voice, musicians walking along both sides of the procession began playing their instruments. Beautiful women scattered flower petals through the air.
hunks.sol: At the shrill cry of a middle-aged man with weasel whiskers, musicians walking along both sides of the procession began to play. Beautiful women scattered flower petals through the air.

hunks.baseline: In an instant, the main road was swept up in a festive atmosphere.
hunks.sol: The main road was instantly swept up in a festive atmosphere.

hunks.baseline: Commoners traveling along the road watched the procession with expressions that mingled expectation and discontent.
hunks.sol: The commoners traveling along it watched the procession with expressions mingling anticipation and discontent.

hunks.baseline: At the end of the countless gazes stood ten men and women riding in sedan chairs engraved with dragons and phoenixes.
hunks.sol: Their countless gazes converged on ten young men and women riding in four-bearer palanquins carved with dragons and phoenixes.

hunks.baseline: They carried themselves with the ease and smiles possessed only by those who had money, looking down at the poorly dressed commoners as they tossed something from their hands.
hunks.sol: Wreathed in the easy smiles only the rich could afford, they looked down at the poorly dressed commoners and tossed something from their hands.

hunks.baseline: Not hidden weapons… money. Shining silver nyang, each worth a hundred iron coins.
hunks.sol: Not hidden weapons… money. Gleaming silver nyang, each worth a hundred iron coins.

hunks.baseline: Only then did I understand why there had been anticipation in the commoners’ expressions.
hunks.sol: Only then did I understand the anticipation on the commoners’ faces.

hunks.baseline: “Jang-pal, you filthy bastard! How dare you try to snatch someone else’s silver nyang? Take your hand off it right now!”
hunks.sol: “Jang-pal, you vile bastard! How dare you try to snatch someone else’s silver nyang? Take your hand off it right now!”

hunks.baseline: “Bullshit. Didn’t you see that my hand got there first?”
hunks.sol: “Bullshit. Didn’t you see my hand get there first?”

hunks.baseline: The cheers and curses of the people covered the falling flower petals and silver nyang.
hunks.sol: Cheers and curses rose over the ceaselessly falling petals and silver nyang.

hunks.baseline: Women bit the silver nyang to test it after their unexpected windfall. Men loudly claimed that they were the rightful owners, then soon began fighting over it.
hunks.sol: A woman bit into her unexpected windfall to test it. Men loudly insisted that they were the rightful owners, then promptly began fighting over it.

hunks.baseline: And the young men and women sitting in the sedan chairs laughed as they watched the spectacle.
hunks.sol: Meanwhile, the young men and women in the palanquins laughed as they watched the spectacle.

hunks.baseline: “What a complete mess.”
hunks.sol: “What a complete shitshow.”

hunks.baseline: It was a sight that made my head shake on its own.
hunks.sol: The sight made me shake my head.

hunks.baseline: The rich kids scattering money and enjoying the people’s reactions as if they were watching a circus looked pathetic. The sight of the commoners fighting tooth and nail for a single silver nyang left a bitter taste in my mouth and made me feel sorry for them.
hunks.sol: Those gold-spoon brats looked pathetic, scattering money and enjoying the commoners’ reactions as though they were watching a circus. The sight of the commoners fighting tooth and nail over a single silver nyang left a bitter taste in my mouth.

hunks.baseline: “Let’s stop worrying about that and get going…”
hunks.sol: “Forget about that. Let’s just get going…”

hunks.baseline: I blinked, unable to finish my sentence.
hunks.sol: I trailed off and blinked.

hunks.baseline: What the hell?
hunks.sol: What the hell was this?

hunks.baseline: The people who had been beside me moments ago were nowhere to be seen. Only the Zhuge Clan retainer remained, standing awkwardly in place.
hunks.sol: The bastards who had been beside me moments ago were nowhere to be seen. Only the Zhuge Clan retainer remained, standing there awkwardly.

hunks.baseline: “Wait, where did all those bastards go?”
hunks.sol: “Wait, where did every one of those bastards go?”

hunks.baseline: One person was darting through the crowd with ghostlike movements, snatching silver nyang out of the air.
hunks.sol: Someone was darting through the crowd with ghostlike footwork, snatching silver nyang out of the air.

hunks.baseline: No. Not one person.
hunks.sol: No. Not someone.

hunks.baseline: That lunatic was actually using a Beggars’ Sect secret technique for this?
hunks.sol: That lunatic was actually using a secret technique of the Beggars’ Sect for this?

hunks.baseline: He was even faster and more agile than he had ever been before. He had complained endlessly that he had only mastered the technique to the fifth stage, yet the movements he was displaying now were at least seventh-stage.
hunks.sol: He was faster and more agile than I had ever seen him. He had complained endlessly that he’d only mastered the technique to the fifth stage, yet the movements he was displaying now were at least seventh-stage.

hunks.baseline: *That bastard is singlehandedly disgracing the Beggars’ Sect.*
hunks.sol: *That bastard is single-handedly disgracing the Beggars’ Sect.*

hunks.baseline: Even if he was a beggar, how could he be this devoted to his calling?
hunks.sol: Even for a beggar, how could he be this devoted to his calling?

hunks.baseline: But as little as I cared about another sect’s reputation, the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s own dark horse was no less impressive.
hunks.sol: But I had no time to worry about another sect’s reputation. The Jin Family of Taiyuan’s own dark horse was no less impressive.

hunks.baseline: “Hah!”
hunks.sol: “Haap!”

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin kicked off the ground and soared into the air before swinging his sword. The silver nyang caught in the powerful, fluid arc flew upward, then came raining down onto the flat of his blade.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin kicked off the ground and soared into the air, swinging his sword. The silver nyang caught in its powerful, fluid arc popped into the air, then showered down onto the flat of his blade.

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin’s face lit up when he checked the silver.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin’s face lit up as he counted the silver.

hunks.baseline: That bastard had ten hits coming, guaranteed.
hunks.sol: That bastard had ten hits coming. Guaranteed.

hunks.baseline: I swallowed the curses rising to my throat and searched for the last remaining person.
hunks.sol: I swallowed the curses rising in my throat and searched for the last remaining person.

hunks.baseline: But I knew Cheongpung’s habits inside and out, so it did not take long to find him.
hunks.sol: But I knew the habits of the creature called Cheongpung inside and out, so it didn’t take me long to find him.

hunks.baseline: “First, ten sweets, please. Oh, and some jeonbyeong too. Not the ones you just picked up—the big ones over there, and make it a generous serving. Wow, thank you! By any chance, where’s the dumpling shop?”
hunks.sol: “First, ten sweets, please. Oh, and some jeonbyeong too. Not the ones you just picked up—the big ones over there, and give me plenty. Wow, thank you! By any chance, where’s the dumpling shop?”

hunks.baseline: As something inside my head broke, I rolled my eyes back and shouted.
hunks.sol: Something inside my head broke. My eyes rolled back until only the whites showed, and I roared.
